recommendation: Defer formal whole-S014 pause; propose one bounded exit-action test. Do not resume account experiments.
mechanism: At the first actual support break, common market/sector decline with stock relative resilience may distinguish recoverable shocks from extra stock weakness.
signal: D first support-break decision close before original E+9. C=(market_return_D<0 and sector_return_D<0); R=(stock_return_D-sector_return_D>=0). Fixed daily close-to-close returns, zero boundaries, exact dates. Missing is not zero.
action: Continue to original H10 only when P<=0 and C and R; otherwise original early exit. No repeated decision or extended deadline.
existing_label: Same-entry B net position return minus R net position return, reused from EX023; no new labels.
comparison_population: All 100 matched closed early-exit events, report 85/15 separately, all seven entry/decision years with explicit date semantics; not only failed years.
comparability: Inspect same-year, same-remaining-days common support and own decline, amplitude, floating PnL distributions. No claim of full confounding adjustment from this zero-fit test.
negative_result_action: Close mechanism; no reverse direction, nearby threshold, new model or automatic data expansion.
insufficient_common_support_action: Report inconclusive; stop this design without automatic extension.
positive_result_action: Review coverage, alternative explanations and account integration before seeking separate authorization; no automatic component promotion.
primary_year: decision_year; entry_year separately retained, neither is account natural-year return
return_inputs: Stock HFQ and canonical 000001.SH / 000813.CSI daily Close[D]/Close[previous SSE session]-1. Exact date match, no filling.
action_delta: B_position_return-R_position_return from existing EX023 episodes; positive means hold better. Baseline R, B, P and candidate are per-event actions, not accounts.
common_support: Within P<=0 and common_decline, strata=(decision_year,remaining_to_H10_sessions). Compare resilient vs extra-weak only in strata containing both, weight by min(n_resilient,n_weak). Preserve all outside-stratum events separately.
confounder_analysis: Report distributions and weighted standardized mean differences in common support using pooled SD of the full eligible nonpositive common-decline cohort. No fitted adjustment, propensity or optimized matching.
concentration: Fixed top-positive contribution deletion k=1,3,5 on candidate-minus-R, candidate-minus-P and raw group contrast; if n<=k report unavailable. No refit or alternate rule.
clusters: Overlapping inclusive [entry_date, max(B_exit_date,R_exit_date)] intervals, transitive connected components across all 100 pairs. Report cluster-equal means and leave-one-cluster-out.

bootstrap.method: Nonoverlapping full SSE calendar blocks within decision-year, include zero-event blocks and short final blocks; resample block count within each year; recompute denominators. Conditional on saved labels; invalid group draws counted, never replaced.

prechecks: Synthetic equality/zero boundaries, missing dates, action algebra, support weights, interval clusters, no first-support-break future inputs.
stopping: One fixed rule. Sparse or absent common support -> inconclusive/no supported component, no broadened rule. Negative action usefulness -> close. No automatic further models/data/accounts.
